killedBy: the About & Legal pane in the assembled HUD (issue #117) builds the documents and the outbound links into the pane
why: The composition failure a unit test on `renderLegalDocuments` structurally cannot see. The documents are still built, the disclosures still exist, every click handler is still wired, and legal.test.ts stays entirely green -- into a detached div. On screen the pane shows its intro prose, the heading "Documents", the sentence promising them, and nothing else. `.hud-legal` is an EMPTY container in the markup on purpose, so there is no missing-element type error either. This is the entry that makes the case asserting the documents are inside `.hud-about` -- rather than merely inside the HUD -- load-bearing.
